name: Teamster
description: Tough worker who keeps ships and stations running. Strong, practical, and good with machinery.

name: Scientist
description: Brilliant researcher seeking knowledge in the void. High intellect, trained in medical and computer skills.

name: Marine
description: Disciplined soldier trained for combat. Excels in firearms, tactics, and keeping the crew alive.

name: Android
description: Synthetic being with logical mind and resilient frame. Superior fear saves but limited stress capacity.
